name: gopatch-skills
description: Mechanical Go refactoring with gopatch — renames, signature changes, call-site sweeps and declaration deletes over the syntax tree instead of sed, perl or awk.

interface.shortDescription: Refactor Go code over the syntax tree
interface.longDescription: Rewrite Go source across many files with gopatch rather than sed, perl or awk: rename types, functions, fields, methods, imports and packages; change signatures; add or delete struct fields; delete declarations that nothing references; and apply patch files that match Go syntax. Includes a cookbook built from real in-place text edits and the gopatch command that replaces each one.
defaultPrompt: Rename the TemplateID field on Finding to CheckID across the module
Drop the mode argument from every getInstance call site
Delete the unusedHelper function and everything that refers to it
